title: The Buildings Inside Cheyenne Mountain Sit on Giant Springs
asof: Figures from US Air Force & Space Force articles · full video on the channel

shots.s: These buildings sit on giant steel springs.
They're inside Cheyenne Mountain, in Colorado.
A command bunker built to survive a nuclear war.
There are fifteen buildings in a cave carved into granite.
They don't touch the rock. There's a gap of about eighteen inches.
Instead, they sit on more than thirteen hundred springs.
Each one weighs over a thousand pounds.
If a blast or an earthquake shakes the mountain,
the buildings bounce instead of breaking.
The front door weighs twenty-five tons.
Would you feel safe in there?
